text: Stop harassing my family. We just lost my father.
Classified: complaint + stop request. dnc_or_stop: yes for Victoria; nothing further to her, not even an argument or explanation.

Dispute steps: preserved; brief notes we wrote only to counsel, twice, with disclosures and an opt-out line. Low exposure. Any further contact on this house only through counsel and only if counsel asks.
Mr. Reed, Victoria has asked us to stop contacting the family, and we will. We'll only respond if you write to us.
For your information: an heir complained; contact has stopped, everything is preserved, no action needed from you.
